```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
data('HairEyeColor')
```

## Hair and Eye Color

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)
```

### Sex Distribution

```{r pie-sex}
Sys.sleep(15)
sex_counts <- margin.table(HairEyeColor, 3)
sex_df <- data.frame(Sex = names(sex_counts), Count = as.numeric(sex_counts))

ggplot(sex_df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(title = "Distribution by Sex") +
  theme_void()
```

### Eye Color Distribution

```{r pie-eye}
eye_counts <- margin.table(HairEyeColor, 2)
eye_df <- data.frame(Eye = names(eye_counts), Count = as.numeric(eye_counts))

ggplot(eye_df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Eye)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Blue = "#5b8dd9", Brown = "#7B4F2E", Green = "#4aab63", Hazel = "#b5813a")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution by Eye Color") +
  theme_void()
```

### Hair Color Distribution

```{r pie-hair}
hair_counts <- margin.table(HairEyeColor, 1)
hair_df <- data.frame(Hair = names(hair_counts), Count = as.numeric(hair_counts))

ggplot(hair_df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Hair)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Black = "#1a1a1a", Blond = "#f5d060", Brown = "#7B4F2E", Red = "#c0392b")) +
  labs(title = "Distribution by Hair Color") +
  theme_void()
```

## Filter by Sex

```{r filter-input, context="render", echo=FALSE}
selectInput(
  "sex_filter",
  label    = "Select Sex:",
  choices  = c("Male", "Female"),
  selected = "Male"
)
```

### Eye Color (Filtered)

```{r eye-filtered-output, echo=FALSE}
plotOutput("eye_filtered_plot")
```

### Hair Color (Filtered)

```{r hair-filtered-output, echo=FALSE}
plotOutput("hair_filtered_plot")
```

```{r server, context="server", echo=FALSE}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  sex <- input$sex_filter
  tbl <- HairEyeColor[, , sex]
  tbl
})

output$eye_filtered_plot <- renderPlot({
  eye_counts <- colSums(filtered_data())
  eye_df <- data.frame(Eye = names(eye_counts), Count = as.numeric(eye_counts))

  ggplot(eye_df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Eye)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Blue = "#5b8dd9", Brown = "#7B4F2E", Green = "#4aab63", Hazel = "#b5813a")) +
    labs(title = paste("Eye Color Distribution —", input$sex_filter)) +
    theme_void()
})

output$hair_filtered_plot <- renderPlot({
  hair_counts <- rowSums(filtered_data())
  hair_df <- data.frame(Hair = names(hair_counts), Count = as.numeric(hair_counts))

  ggplot(hair_df, aes(x = "", y = Count, fill = Hair)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Black = "#1a1a1a", Blond = "#f5d060", Brown = "#7B4F2E", Red = "#c0392b")) +
    labs(title = paste("Hair Color Distribution —", input$sex_filter)) +
    theme_void()
})
```
